source.piers: UT LIS Campus_Buildings object 480 BEL ring (queried 2026-10-20), west-edge notches = twin structural piers
source.envelope: bowl outer wall measured with physics rays in the lane scene without the b09 install (research round2/envelope.json); stadium stats {"triangles":  31484, "retractedMetres":  96, "meanDepth":  75.18571428571428}; bowlBaseline re-measured 2026-10-23 after the per-side DKR profiles (stadium-bowl.ts STAND_PROFILES), scene with the b09 install failed = no-install bowl
source.board: texaslonghorns.com facility page (160 x 44 ft, 2021 SEZ) + official 2022 aerials; see tools/scans/stadium-references.json
source.southWall: first generated-bowl surface of south-to-north rays at Y 12.5 (SEZ facade on the central block, open-stand underside at the corners) and the bowl top 0.5 m inside it; re-measured 2026-10-23 after the per-side DKR profiles (tools/scans/stadium-southwall.mjs)

board.note: 2021 SEZ board: official 160 x 44 ft screen (texaslonghorns.com/facilities/memorial-stadium/1, 'Atop it all is a 160-foot by 44-foot videoboard'); centred on the field axis (official 2022 aerials ref-ut-pano0009/ref-ut-dji0226); stands on the roof of the central SEZ club block (stadium-bowl.ts STAND_PROFILES.south, roof Y 17.96) at its field face (SEZ_FACE, faceGap in front); header band (DARRELL K ROYAL / TEXAS MEMORIAL STADIUM, ref-ut-dkr2) height 2.0 m = estimate; its top stays under the City 2023 SEZ top Y 35.0 that the flank towers reach. Replaces the 2006-era 55.85 x 134.38 ft record (historic Godzillatron size, not the modern board).

facadeTopEvidence.source: district-orbits-30m d19-exterior-northwest; full-map-30m priority-07, b09-r1-a1-30m-r2, priority-09 (usable-context); official GIS pier notches projected with each sidecar actual camera/target, 60 deg vertical FOV, 1280x720 (lane .work/claude-district40/calib/project.mjs)
facadeTopEvidence.note: Top of the Bellmont west block measured by projection in three frames: Y 31.6 (b09-r1-a1-30m-r2, pier 226), 32.5 (priority-07, pier 254), 32.6 (priority-09, pier 331); mean 32.2, uncertainty about +-2 m (tile geometry, perspective). Above it the upper-deck rear sets back to the bowl wall, which the generated bowl already supplies (west wall x(z) is vertical from Y 18 to 40 in round2/envelope.json). Previously the facade rose on the GIS line to the bowl rim (41.75-46.5), hiding that setback.

fin.note: Rib count of the upper panel is not resolvable in any reviewed frame (a bay is ~45 px wide). 10 fins of the frontage fin section (0.19 m) is the largest count whose equal slots (>= 0.567 m in the narrowest bay) stay wider than the 0.55 m no-cavity rule; 12 (the frontage/Street View count for the lower fin zone) would leave 0.45 m slots.

notBuilt: North bays z 207-254 (grille bays in the same frames) remain unbuilt: the San Jacinto sidewalk runs inside the GIS strip there.
South return bays z 330.5-344.4 (GIS notches at 339.8/344.4, banded in priority-09) are outside this 8-bay pilot.
Tall pale pylon near z 250-256 rising to the upper deck (b09-r1-a1-30m-r2, priority-07): position not measurable from these frames; not built.
Upper-deck rear skeletal frames above the setback: shared bowl/scan, not touched.
